identification: 8 framed colour reproduction prints of early colonial Tasmanian views, in gold frames with green mounts (2 visible) and pale pink/grey frames (stack behind). Subjects seen: Mount Wellington and Hobart Town from Kangaroo Point style views (x2, John Glover composition), The Nut at Circular Head with emus and sheep, a lake and cattle scene with ranges, Hobart waterfront and town with cattle (x1), a mill or houses at a cove, and a rural scene with figures. Photo 9 shows halftone dot screen, so these are offset reproductions, not original watercolours or hand-coloured lithographs. Artist and publisher not readable (captions too small).
